newsitem.title: USA: Hawks Atlanta arena gets final OK from Fulton Cty.
newsitem.headline: Hawks Atlanta arena gets final OK from Fulton Cty.

text.p: Georgia's Fulton County Commission approved a $213 million basketball stadium for the Hawks in a 6-1 vote Wednesday, a commission aide said.
The approval was the last one needed for the downtown arena, which already had been approved by the Atlanta City Council and the Atlanta-Fulton County Recreation Authority.
Turner Broadcasting System Inc plans to build the arena for the Atlanta Hawks and possibly a National Hockey League expansion team.

The plan calls for the arena to be financed with taxable bonds issued by the recreation authority. Turner has pledged to cover any shortfall if team revenues are insufficient to pay the $12 million annual debt service.
Additionally, $72 million of tax-exempt bonds will be issued to fund public improvements around the facility, with debt service paid from a 3 percent car rental tax.
